location.tagline: Last three masters. Up top, then down.

mission.note: The last three masters, roof to street, then the IPX truck. About six minutes.

holdout.name: Hold the Square
holdout.note: Endless waves over the square. How long can you hold it?

mission: Take back the last three master reels

intro.text: {name}, it's the Vault. Last three masters are on these roofs and down in the square. Their buyer wants your album on the big screens at midnight. Not tonight.

introHoldout.text: {name}, it's the Vault. The square's full of Vultures. Hold it down as long as you can.

reel.text: One back. Every roof heard that. More coming.
Two. One left out there. They're throwing everything at you now.
That's all three. The IPX truck's rolling up on Forty-Sixth, east of the square. Move.

done.text: Every master's home. The city's yours, {name}.

plan: Three masters: the tank house up top, the gantry behind the big screen, the booth under the stand.
Work down the roofs. Stairs and the scaffold get you to the street.
When all three are in, the IPX truck comes for you on Forty-Sixth.

loading.title: Midtown
loading.line: Midnight over the square. Last three masters.

hints.reel7: The tanks are one roof down from the top. Steel stair on the east side of the high roof.
hints.reel8: The gantry's behind the big screen, on the low roof. Stairs at the south edge of the tank roof.
hints.reel9: The booth's under the stand, north end of the square. Scaffold off the gantry, or the service stair inside.
hints.extraction: The truck's on Forty-Sixth, east of the square. Down Broadway, past the bus.
